info.title: TimeAPI Universal API
info.description: TimeAPI provides public REST endpoints for current time, Unix timestamps, and IANA timezone lookup data.

get.description: Retrieves the current time by coordinates from TimeAPI.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

date_time.description: Current local date and time for the coordinates.

dst_active.description: Whether daylight saving time is active.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.summary: Get Current Time By Time Zone
get.description: Retrieves the current time for an IANA time zone from TimeAPI.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Full IANA time zone name, for example Europe/Amsterdam.

schema.description: Full IANA time zone name, for example Europe/Amsterdam.

date_time.description: Current local date and time in the requested timezone.

dst_active.description: Whether daylight saving time is active.
